title: All You Need is Amplifier: Spectral Imposters Without Pulse Shaping
summary: Quantum tracking control encodes the desired dynamics into a tailored driving field; here, we let the system find its own way there. We propose a real-time feedback control framework in which a proportional controller continuously corrects a simple transform-limited field based on the instantaneous mismatch between two systems' responses - producing the required control on the fly, without prior waveform design.
